name: Gift-exchange game
summary: A two-player employer-employee game modeling reciprocity where wage and effort choices trade off self-interest against mutual gain.
rules_text: This is a two-player sequential game. Player 1 is Employer, Player 2 is Employee. Employer moves first and chooses a wage: High or Low (or any higher vs lower amount). Employee observes the wage and then chooses effort: High or Low. Payoffs: Employer's payoff increases with employee effort and decreases with wage. Employee's payoff increases with wage and decreases with effort. Both receive higher payoff from High wage + High effort than Low wage + Low effort, but individually Employee prefers Low effort for any wage, and anticipating that Employer prefers Low wage. Play is one shot; in repeated versions roles and pairings reset each round.
rating_reason: Sequential two-player salary-effort game, clear payoffs
